newsitem.title: USA: Arson fire damages black church in Georgia.
newsitem.headline: Arson fire damages black church in Georgia.

text.p: An arson fire caused major damage to a 108-year-old church with a predominantly black congregation in this suburban Atlanta community Wednesday, fire authorities said.
State officials said it was the seventh suspicious church fire in Georgia this year.

Officials said the fire at the Galilee Missionary Baptist Church had been started in at least six different places. "We have a definite incendiary fire," Cobb County Fire Department investigator Dave Herndon said.
The cinder-block church, which had a congregation of about 50 members, is in a secluded area about 20 miles northwest of Atlanta. Most of the damage occurred in the sanctuary.
Deacon Walter McConnell said insurance may not cover all of the damage, which he estimated was as much as $100,000. "It's absolutely heartbreaking," he said.
The early-morning fire was discovered by a Cobb County police officer.
